name: bay-shots
checks: CHECKS.md, Commissary look and payment (0.9.10), rows 6 to 8 and 12; Bays on the door's side and a heavier truck, rows B2 to B5

steps.note: Use FT saves from a new character of their own, never a series city saved under a new name. Before running, prepare and save 'FT bay-shots' by hand: an FT city with the five commissaries, all screens closed. The bridge cannot create a new game. This note is manual setup, not an automated check.
Visual review only. Mock PNGs are placeholders. A person judges paint, signs, props, door clearances and pedestrian collisions.
